record_type_quote: Whereas we consistently replicated the increase in memory distrust across repeated trials that is typically found with the stove-checking task, the checking component of each trial is neither necessary nor sufficient for the accrual of memory distrust.

targets.evidence_quote: The purpose of Experiment 1 was to further explore whether memory accuracy and metamemory scores, including confidence, decrease across repeated trials in the absence of the checking stage of each trial. Medway and Jones (2013) showed that repeated trials without the checking stage caused a decrease in memory confidence roughly equivalent to repeated trials with checking.
targets.outcome_quote: Confidence decreased across trials even when the checking component was eliminated.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Publisher preview identifies Experiment 1 as retesting the finding of decreased confidence without checking reported by Medway and Jones (2013). Abstract reports the same result. No full reference available; authors are only supplied in in-text form.
